$comment: Gateway events each mobile client intentionally does not handle yet, with a one-line reason. Consumed by scripts/check-protocol-event-coverage.mjs (pnpm check:protocol-coverage). Adding a gateway event without a client handler requires either handling it or adding an entry here; the check also fails when an entry goes stale (event removed or now handled).

ios.controlUi.sessionPullRequests.changed: Sidebar PR indicators are a Control UI surface; native apps do not render session PR chips.
ios.cron: Cron run activity is not surfaced in the iOS app.
ios.device.pair.changed: Device label projection refresh is a Control UI surface; iOS does not render the Gateway Devices page.
ios.device.pair.requested: Device pairing flows poll via device.pair.* methods on iOS.
ios.device.pair.resolved: Device pairing flows poll via device.pair.* methods on iOS.
ios.device.pair.setup.completed: Generated setup lifecycle is a Control UI surface; iOS direct Watch setup completes through Watch connectivity.
ios.device.pair.setup.deliveryUncertain: Generated setup recovery is a Control UI surface; native clients receive the handoff response directly.
ios.gateway.suspension: Gateway suspension account-footer presentation is a Control UI surface; iOS does not render this footer.
ios.heartbeat: iOS liveness uses tick and WebSocket-level ping; heartbeat is unused.
ios.mentions.changed: Personal Inbox invalidation is a Control UI surface; iOS does not expose the temporary mentions Inbox.
ios.node.hostStats: Host resource meters are a Control UI surface; iOS does not render them.
ios.node.pair.requested: Node pairing state is fetched on demand; no push consumer on iOS yet.
ios.node.pair.resolved: Node pairing state is fetched on demand; no push consumer on iOS yet.
ios.node.presence: Node activity is reported by macOS nodes and consumed by gateway routing; iOS has no presence reporter yet.
ios.node.runnerInventory.changed: Session-host placement refresh is a Control UI surface; iOS does not offer device runner placement yet.
ios.openclaw.approval.requested: OpenClaw system-agent config approvals are a web/desktop operator surface; iOS has no operator-approval prompt.
ios.openclaw.approval.resolved: OpenClaw system-agent config approvals are a web/desktop operator surface; iOS has no operator-approval prompt.
ios.plugin.approval.requested: Plugin approval prompts are not implemented on iOS.
ios.plugin.approval.resolved: Plugin approval prompts are not implemented on iOS.
ios.portal.changed: Control-UI-only surface; native apps have no portal viewer yet.
ios.presence: Presence roster is a control-UI (web/desktop) surface; iOS does not render it.
ios.session.approval: Native approval review uses exec.approval push/nudge delivery; the session-scoped approval stream is a Control UI chat surface.
ios.session.operation: Chat UI derives run state from chat/agent events; no session.operation consumer yet.
ios.session.sharing: Session visibility/membership management is a Control UI operator surface; iOS reads visibility/sharingRole from session rows and has no sharing editor.
ios.session.sharing.evidence: Principal-less sharing evidence is a Control UI operator surface; iOS refreshes canonical session rows through sessions.changed.
ios.session.suggestion: The suggestion queue is a Control UI collaboration surface; iOS does not render or resolve session suggestions.
ios.session.tool: Session tool stream is not rendered by the iOS chat surface yet.
ios.session.typing: Collaborative typing state is a Control UI-only ephemeral indicator; iOS does not render it.
ios.shutdown: iOS relies on socket close plus reconnect/backoff instead of the shutdown notice.
ios.skills.changed: Skills settings is a macOS operator surface; iOS does not expose skill management yet.
ios.task.suggestion: Task suggestion cards are a Control UI-only surface; iOS does not render them.
ios.terminal.data: Embedded terminal is a web/desktop surface; iOS has no terminal client.
ios.terminal.exit: Embedded terminal is a web/desktop surface; iOS has no terminal client.
ios.ui.command: Web Control UI-only layout commands; iOS does not consume them.
ios.update.available: Gateway self-update notices do not apply to iOS; app updates ship via the App Store.
ios.voicewake.routing.changed: iOS only consumes voicewake.changed trigger updates; routing changes are not surfaced.
